newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Blue chips, Creative lead Singapore stocks up.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips, Creative lead Singapore stocks up.

text.p: Singapore shares opened firmer in early Monday trade on strong buying of blue chips and selective electronic counters, dealers said.
"Strong buying of Creative is leading the other selected electronic counters higher," a dealer with a European bank said.
Another dealer said Creative was firm after electronic counters in the U.S. traded heavily in anticipation of strong year-end festive demand.
At 0200 GMT, Creative headed gainers after rising Singapore $1.70 (US$1.21) to $12.20 on 664,200 shares. The SES electronic index was up 2.08 percent at 87.01.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index rose 0.5 percent to 2,201.33.
Expectations of a recovery in the electronic industry in 1997 also inspired buying of electronics stocks, dealers said.
They said foreign tranches of blue chips and banks were among the first to rebound after Friday's plunge.
Turnover was light around 21 million shares, with gainers leading losers by 96 to 22.
Leading the actives was Dairy Farm with 2.3 million shares, of which 2.0 million were crossed at US$0.76. Uraco saw 1.6 million shares crossed at $0.86-0.88.
